title: Babylon Fortress
geometryBasis: OSM way 215304756 defines the standing southern round tower. Way 197960953 anchors the base of the northern tower. The 1884 measured plan and the mapped Hanging Church locate the outlines of the south gate.
sectionBasis: Butler’s surveyed five stone courses with three brick courses between them and an outer masonry diameter of approximately 29 m establish the preserved walls. The south gate profile and bastion ends follow the original 1809 engraving.
limitations: The modeled north tower stops at the Roman wall beneath Saint George. The unrelated church superstructures and museum are separate physical structures.
The dates of the surveys differ from the current setting. The historic gate sections, exact interior floor elevations, exposed masonry breaks and archaeological court levels are approximated.
